landing.howTitle: Four steps to a page that moves
landing.howDescription: See the result first. Make each decision yourself.
howDescriptions: Upload a custom GLB, use the reference model, or generate from an image when the service opens.
Project text and symbols onto the model; adjust size and rotation.
Capture camera stops into a tour that reveals your stories.

landing.faqDescription: A few things to know before you start.
faqQuestions: Do I need to code or model?
Can I redo the look and stickers?
How do I share the page?
faqAnswers: No. Edit the model, stickers, cameras and page content visually.
You can start in minutes. Completion depends on your content and cameras; image generation takes additional time.
Yes. Edit, hide, duplicate or remove stickers and recapture cameras.
Download standalone HTML or publish a saved version and bind your domain when hosting opens.
Manual editing, export and private saving are free. Image generation shows ANS point costs before you confirm.
Edits stay in memory until saved to ANS. Image generation sends your reference image to tripo3d.uk after confirmation. Public publishing requires a separate confirmation.

tour.modelNote: Public reference model, or upload a custom GLB for local editing and export.
tour.layerNote: Select a layer to edit its text, size and rotation. Upper layers cover lower layers.
tour.noLayers: Choose a sticker on the right, then click the model to place it.
tour.captureNote: Rotate, zoom or pan the scene before capturing. New stops capture the current view.
tour.sharedSettings: Lighting and effects apply to the whole page.
tour.title: Title
tour.subtitle: Subtitle
tour.loadingNote: The loading screen closes when the model is ready.
tour.placeHint: Click the model to place a sticker
tour.dragHint: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom · Middle-drag to pan
tour.stickerNote: Text and symbol stickers are projected onto the model. No photos are generated or uploaded.
tour.deliveryNote: Review your byline, hero and every camera stop before saving or exporting. Downloads include the model, stickers and cameras. Saved versions can be published when hosting opens.
tour.uploadLimit: Self-contained GLB · max 5 MB · read locally
tour.localModelSave: Custom models stay local. Export a website or editable file; account versions do not store model files yet.
tour.modelInvalid: Use a self-contained, uncompressed GLB 2.0 under 5 MB. The current model is preserved.
tour.undoReplacement: Undo the last deletion, replacement or restore
tour.saveSizeLimit: This exceeds the 100 KB account version limit. Shorten the text, or download the website and editable file to keep your work.
tour.scenePending: The model is loading. Camera capture will be available shortly.
tour.sceneFailed: Model loading failed. Your content is kept. Reload the canvas or choose a valid GLB.
tour.captureFailed: Camera capture failed. Your content is retained; try again once the model is ready.
tour.invalidField: Check “{field}”: complete the field or correct its format and length before saving.
tour.loginDraftNote: Signing in leaves this editor. Download your editable file first and import it after signing in; unsaved local edits are not saved automatically.
